name: crm-redirect-intelligence
description: SaaS-style CRM + redirect cloaking + analytics + lead capture + email automation on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.sync:assets: cp src/public/dashboard.js src/public-admin/ && cp src/public/styles.css src/public-admin/ && cp src/public/lead.js src/public-customer/ && cp src/public/styles.css src/public-customer/
scripts.deploy: npm run sync:assets && wrangler deploy && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.public.jsonc
scripts.deploy:public: npm run sync:assets && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.public.jsonc
scripts.secrets:resend: npx wrangler secret put RESEND_API_KEY && npx wrangler secret put RESEND_API_KEY -c wrangler.public.jsonc
scripts.desktop: cd desktop && npm install && npm start
scripts.desktop:dist: cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist
